'''''Perseverance''''' was a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''Perseverance'' served in the [[Home Fleet Strike Group Five/Legends|Home Fleet Strike Group Five]] and helped to trap the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] at the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].
